description: This file manages thread priorities and scheduling policies for Raspberry Pi 4, including setting thread schedulers to idle, other, or round-robin with specific priorities, and retrieving thread priorities.

methods.name: SetIdleScheduler
methods.description: Sets the current thread to use the idle scheduler (lowest priority).

methods.name: SetOtherScheduler
methods.description: Sets the current thread to use the default scheduler.

methods.name: SetRoundRobinScheduler
methods.description: Configures the thread to use round-robin scheduling with a specified priority, considering system limits.

methods.name: ThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets thread priority based on the provided SbThreadPriority enum.
